method: Direct collection from official Chinese AI-company career systems (Feishu/ATSX job-board APIs, Tencent careers API, Moka boards via headless-browser DOM extraction); title-based Core and Extended taxonomy; keyword-family pre-filter for boards larger than 10,000 roles; no search-result estimates.
marketCounting: National counts are unique jobs. City counts are job-location appearances: one multi-city job is counted once in every named city, so city totals may exceed national totals.

aggregators.principle: Aggregator signals are sampled discovery data, displayed separately from official-board counts and never merged.

sources.note: 未登录状态，每个关键词最多约 3 页
anti-automation: 猎聘对 CDP 控制的浏览器返回空白页（无头/有头均拦截），仅真人浏览器可访问
